pages.text: Place the specified block state at the spell's block position, subject to engine modification rules. Sample a block item using the reference slot.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 200 per placement attempt. Node settings choose the block and facing.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1, regardless of the chosen block.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: Using This Node
pages.text: You do not need to attach any more nodes here. Insert it, then select it to adjust its settings on the right. Right-click it on the canvas to take it back.
